exzentrisch.et: From Medieval Latin excentricus, compare eccentros, ἔκκεντρος (ékkentros).

s: Excellency (form of address for certain high officials or dignitaries)

exzellent.et: Borrowed from Latin excellēns. Cognate with English excellent.
